label: transactions.is_fraud
semantic_meaning: Recorded boolean fraud flag; confirmation process, source and availability time undocumented
known_leakage_risks: fraud_score may encode the label or shared synthetic generation; post-event flag; severe imbalance
known_linkage_limitations: Unique transaction; ownership validated, but no complaint-transaction link
potential_use: Candidate transaction-level fraud label only after provenance, timing and held-out validation

label: complaints.status
semantic_meaning: Recorded case lifecycle state; Resolved does not mean customer was right
known_leakage_risks: Snapshot can reflect future resolution relative to creation and cutoff
known_linkage_limitations: No transaction_id; affected product ownership is inconsistent; origin interaction absent
potential_use: Possible case lifecycle endpoint after defining time horizon and censoring

label: complaints.compensation_granted
semantic_meaning: Recorded numeric compensation; zero/positive is not a fraud verdict
known_leakage_risks: Post-resolution action and policy selection; missingness depends on lifecycle
known_linkage_limitations: No verified complaint-transaction linkage; currencies cannot be pooled
potential_use: Observable monetary outcome by currency; unsuitable as ground truth of fraud or dispute validity

label: complaints.resolution_satisfaction
semantic_meaning: Recorded resolution satisfaction; scale anchors and collection timing undocumented
known_leakage_risks: Observed after resolution; response/selection bias; cannot stand for all complaints
known_linkage_limitations: Complaint-level only; no safe transaction linkage
potential_use: Possible respondent satisfaction endpoint after scale and sampling validation

label: call_center_interactions.was_resolved
semantic_meaning: Recorded interaction resolution flag, not transaction dispute adjudication
known_leakage_risks: Post-contact flag; availability time and resolution criteria unknown
known_linkage_limitations: Customer linkage exists, but no explicit transaction linkage or complaint-origin link
potential_use: Possible interaction-level service outcome after semantic validation

label: call_center_interactions.was_escalated
semantic_meaning: Recorded escalation flag; not a normative ground-truth decision to escalate
known_leakage_risks: Historical human/policy selection; post-contact flag and timing unknown
known_linkage_limitations: Interaction-level only; cannot transfer to arbitrary customer transactions
potential_use: Possible historical escalation endpoint after policy and timestamp validation
